mapper.select: SELECT user_id, new_email, code, expires_at, attempt_count, created_at FROM email_change_requests WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_change_requests (user_id, new_email, code, expires_at, attempt_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{newEmail}, #{code}, #{expiresAt}, 0) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET new_email = #{newEmail}, code = #{code}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, attempt_count = 0, created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
